notes:
REF-BM-02: Fetches title and description only; favicon and preview image are not collected.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable, but description is conflated with the separate note field.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but there is no description field.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are saved as new bookmarks without detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-07: Cards show titles, note text, tags, and generated initials, not a distinct description and fetched favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag input has no autocomplete for existing tags.
REF-BM-11: Tag filtering works only for the first six generated tag buttons; other tags cannot be selected.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and note, but no distinct description field exists.
REF-BM-14: The #tag query syntax is not implemented.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: No action can target all bookmarks in the current filtered scope.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed only as escaped plain text, not rendered Markdown.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Collections are simple single-value categories, not reusable search/include/exclude bundles.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Sort and layout can be changed transiently, but personal display settings are neither configurable nor persisted.
